name: psst
description: Please Send Smarter Thoughts: ask Sonnet, Haiku, Opus, or Fable one question from inside any Claude Code session without switching models. /psst <model> <message>, or the shortcuts /s /h /o /f (/sonnet /haiku /opus /fable). Replies are tagged and short, and noisy work runs in a subagent so the session never compacts.
